label: Bible Study
prompt: So then _____ cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verse: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
note: Why preaching matters — faith arrives through the ear.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the _____, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
verse: David said moreover, The LORD that delivered me out of the paw of the lion, and out of the paw of the bear, he will deliver me out of the hand of this Philistine. And Saul said unto David, Go, and the LORD be with thee.
note: David's résumé for fighting Goliath: God saved me from the lion and the bear; He'll handle this one too.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of _____: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
verse: And as Jesus passed forth from thence, he saw a man, named Matthew, sitting at the receipt of custom: and he saith unto him, Follow me. And he arose, and followed him.
note: 'Receipt of custom' was the tax booth — Matthew was on the job collecting taxes when Jesus said, 'Follow me.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do _____ the Lord's death till he come.
verse: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord's death till he come.
note: Every Lord's Supper is a sermon: the bread and cup proclaim his death — with a built-in 'till he come.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent _____ me, and I did eat.
verse: And the LORD God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
note: The first passing of the buck: Adam blamed the woman, and the woman blamed the serpent that 'beguiled' her.
